scenario_title_zh: 圆编制造与大圆机沟通

rounds.ai_message: Good morning. This is Tony from Foshan Huayu Knitting. How can I help you?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 早上好，我是佛山华宇针织的 Tony，请问有什么可以帮您？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 自我介绍，说明要采购针织面料
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I want buy fabric'; say 'We are looking for knitted fabric'.
rounds.tips_zh: 电话开场先报公司名和采购品类，再讲用途。
rounds.user_response_example: Good morning, Tony. This is Amy from Ningbo Star Garments. We are looking for knitted fabric for our T-shirt line.

rounds.ai_message: Sure, Amy. We run circular knitting machines from 24G to 32G. What gauge do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的 Amy。我们的大圆机从 24G 到 32G 都有。你需要什么机号？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回答机号和纱支搭配
rounds.common_mistakes: gauge 就是机号，直接说 28G 或 28-gauge；不要说 machine number。
rounds.tips_zh: 26s-30s 棉纱常配 24G-28G；32s-40s 精梳配 28G-32G。
rounds.user_response_example: We need 28-gauge for 26s combed cotton, single jersey.

rounds.ai_message: Got it. Single jersey on 28G is easy for us. What GSM and tube width do you want?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。28G 单面布对我们很简单。克重和筒状门幅要多少？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明克重和筒径
rounds.common_mistakes: GSM 前直接说数字：160 GSM；不要说 weight is 160。
rounds.tips_zh: 筒径 30 英寸配 28G，T 恤面料开幅后约 68-72 英寸。
rounds.user_response_example: Around 160 GSM, on a 30-inch cylinder. That gives us about 70 inches open width after finishing.

rounds.ai_message: OK. How many kilograms do you need? Our MOQ is 300 kg per color.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。需要多少公斤？我们每色起订量 300 公斤。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明总数量和颜色数
rounds.common_mistakes: 针织布按公斤计价，不是按米；说 kg 不说 meter。
rounds.tips_zh: 圆编毛坯布 MOQ 一般按 kg 算，每色 300-500 kg 常见。
rounds.user_response_example: The total is about 2,000 kg in three colors. 300 kg per color is fine.

rounds.ai_message: Perfect. For 160 GSM single jersey greige fabric, the price is US$3.20 per kg. Lead time is 15 days.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。160 克重单面毛坯布，价格每公斤 3.2 美元，交期 15 天。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认价格，尝试议价
rounds.common_mistakes: greige fabric 读作 gray fabric 也可以，但别写成 grey goods 混用。
rounds.tips_zh: 毛坯布 greige 价格是针织成本大头；量大可压 3-5%。
rounds.user_response_example: Lead time is OK. But for 2,000 kg, could you do US$3.05 per kg? We have repeat orders coming.

rounds.ai_message: I can do US$3.10, that is my best. Do you need the greige fabric delivered to your dye house directly?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 我最低 3.1 美元。毛坯布要直接送到你的染厂吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认送货地点和方式
key_phrases: Yes, deliver to our dye house
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要说 send to dyeing factory，用 deliver to our dye house。
rounds.tips_zh: 毛坯布直送染厂省一次搬运，但要提前给染厂收货窗口时间。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, please deliver the greige fabric directly to our dye house in Shaoxing. I will email you the address today.

rounds.ai_message: Noted. One more thing — we inspect every roll before delivery. Do you want the inspection report by email?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 记下了。还有一件事——我们每卷坯布出厂前都检验。检验报告要发你邮箱吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认要检验报告
rounds.common_mistakes: inspection report 前面加 the 或 an；不要漏冠词。
rounds.tips_zh: 坯布检验报告要按卷列疵点，染厂投坯前会复查。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, please send the inspection report roll by roll, with the delivery note.

rounds.ai_message: Sure. I will send the PI tomorrow: 2,000 kg single jersey, 28G, 160 GSM, US$3.10 per kg, 15 days. Anything else?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。我明天发 PI：2,000 公斤单面布，28G，160 克重，每公斤 3.1 美元，15 天。还有别的吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 PI 邮箱，结束通话
rounds.common_mistakes: 结尾别只说 OK bye；确认邮箱和下一步。
rounds.tips_zh: PI 上写清机号、克重、筒径、单价、交期，避免后续争议。
rounds.user_response_example: Please send the PI to amy@stargarments.com. Looking forward to working with you. Have a nice day, Tony.

rounds.ai_message: Hi Amy, Tony from Huayu Knitting. I saw your inquiry for cotton interlock. Before I quote, what yarn count and gauge are you targeting?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 嗨 Amy，我是华宇针织 Tony。看到你棉毛布的询价。报价前问一下，目标纱支和机号是多少？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明纱支、机号和布种
rounds.common_mistakes: interlock 是棉毛布/双罗纹，不要和 rib（罗纹）混着说。
rounds.tips_zh: 40s 精梳配 32G 做 interlock，布面细腻，适合中高档 Polo 和内衣。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Tony. We are targeting 40s combed cotton interlock on 32-gauge, for premium polo shirts.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Our 32G interlock machines are 34-inch cylinder with 84 feeders. What GSM and stitch length do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。我们 32G 棉毛机是 34 英寸筒径、84 路。克重和线圈长度要多少？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 给出克重和线圈长度要求
rounds.common_mistakes: stitch length 单位是毫米；不要说 loop size。
rounds.tips_zh: 线圈长度越短，布越紧密克重越高；interlock 200 GSM 常配 0.27-0.30 mm。
rounds.user_response_example: Around 200 GSM with a tight construction. Please keep the stitch length at 0.28 mm, we will confirm after the strike-off.

rounds.ai_message: OK. With 0.28 mm stitch length, the output per machine drops a bit. Is 200 GSM your target after dyeing, or on greige?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。0.28 mm 的线圈长度，单机产量会降一点。200 克重是染后目标还是坯布目标？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明克重是坯布还是成品口径
rounds.common_mistakes: 一定说清 greige GSM 还是 finished GSM，差 5-8%。
rounds.tips_zh: 染整后克重一般比坯布高 5-10%（树脂/定型回潮），谈价以成品克重为准。
rounds.user_response_example: 200 GSM is the finished target. Greige can be around 185 GSM, and we will reach 200 after dyeing and compaction.

rounds.ai_message: Clear. For 40s interlock greige at that spec, the knitting charge is US$1.15 per kg, yarn cost separate. Or do you want a full-package price?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 清楚。这个规格的 40 支棉毛坯布，织造工费每公斤 1.15 美元，纱钱另算。还是你要包纱的一口价？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 选择工费模式还是包纱模式
rounds.common_mistakes: full-package 是包纱包织一口价；别说 total price。
rounds.tips_zh: 自供纱可省 3-5%，但要管纱线库存和运输；小单建议包纱。
rounds.user_response_example: Please quote the full-package price first. If it is not competitive, we may switch to supplying our own yarn and pay the knitting charge only.

rounds.ai_message: Understood. Full package with 40s combed, US$4.60 per kg, MOQ 500 kg per color. Lead time 20 days after yarn arrives.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。包 40 支精梳纱一口价每公斤 4.6 美元，每色起订 500 公斤。纱到后 20 天交期。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 议价并确认交期起算点
key_phrases: lead time starts from yarn arrival
rounds.common_mistakes: 交期起算点要说清 after yarn arrives，不是 after order。
rounds.tips_zh: 包纱单交期从纱线到厂起算，要在 PI 写明，避免扯皮。
rounds.user_response_example: For 2,400 kg total, could you do US$4.45 per kg? And please state clearly that lead time starts from yarn arrival at your mill.

rounds.ai_message: US$4.50 is my bottom line. Now about quality — how do you want us to handle inspection? Four-point system or your own checker?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 4.5 美元是我的底线。质量方面——检验怎么做？四分制还是你们派人查？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明检验方式和疵点标准
rounds.common_mistakes: four-point system 是针织验布常用四分制；不要说 four points way。
rounds.tips_zh: 坯布四分制一般控制在每 100 公斤 20 分以内；重点查漏针、花针、横条。
rounds.user_response_example: Please run the four-point system on every roll, with total points below 20 per 100 kg. Our QC will do a random check before shipment.

rounds.ai_message: Fine. What defects should we watch most? Last time your dye house complained about needle lines and oil stains.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 可以。哪些疵点要重点防？上次你们染厂投诉过针路和油污。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 列出重点疵点并要求预防措施
rounds.common_mistakes: needle line 是针路/花针；dropped stitch 是漏针，别混。
rounds.tips_zh: 针路多因织针磨损，要求定期换针；油污要求机台清洁和卷布防护。
rounds.user_response_example: Please watch needle lines and oil stains most, plus dropped stitches. We expect needle changes every 72 running hours and clean machine beds.

rounds.ai_message: Agreed. I will issue the PI today: 2,400 kg 40s interlock, 32G, 34-inch cylinder, 200 finished GSM, US$4.50 per kg full package, four-point inspection below 20 points. Please confirm by Friday.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同意。我今天发 PI：2,400 公斤 40 支棉毛布，32G，34 英寸筒径，成品 200 克重，包纱每公斤 4.5 美元，四分制检验每百公斤 20 分以内。请周五前确认。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 PI 条款并安排内部审批
rounds.common_mistakes: PI 确认前先核对机号、筒径、克重口径（坯布/成品）。
rounds.tips_zh: 把疵点标准和检验方式写进 PI 或品质协议，索赔时才有依据。
rounds.user_response_example: The PI terms look fine. We will confirm by Friday. Please make sure the greige inspection reports are attached to each shipment.

rounds.ai_message: Amy, Tony here. Before we talk numbers, I have to be straight with you — our 32G interlock machines are fully booked until the 15th. If you need greige before month-end, I can only offer 28G rib or squeeze you in with a rush surcharge. Which way do you want to go?
rounds.ai_message_zh: Amy，我是 Tony。谈价格之前先跟你说实话——我们 32G 棉毛机排到 15 号以后了。月底前要坯布的话，只能上 28G 罗纹，或者加急费插单。你想怎么走？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 评估插单加急或改规格，提出自己的底线
key_phrases: how much is the rush surcharge
rounds.common_mistakes: 别急着接受加急费；先问金额和产能细节再表态。
rounds.tips_zh: 旺季插单费一般加 3-8%；可谈分批交货替代全部加急。
rounds.user_response_example: The polo program is locked at 32G interlock, so rib is not an option. Tell me the rush surcharge, and whether you can split it — half by month-end, half on your normal schedule.

rounds.ai_message: Rush is 6% on the first half. For that I can free up one 34-inch machine by running your yarn on the night shift. But I need your yarn in-house within 5 days, or the slot is gone.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 前半单加急 6%。我可以排夜班腾出一台 34 英寸机。但你的纱 5 天内必须到厂，否则机位就没了。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认纱线到厂时间，把加急费压下来
rounds.common_mistakes: 口头承诺机位没用；要求写进 PI 并带违约条款。
rounds.tips_zh: 插单谈判要双向约束：你保纱到时间，他保机位，互相写罚则。
rounds.user_response_example: Our yarn can be in-house in 4 days with a couriered cone sample first. In return, cap the rush surcharge at 4%, and put a penalty clause in the PI if the slot slips on your side.

rounds.ai_message: Four percent with a mutual penalty — fair enough. Now the hard part: your last greige lot had barre across 8% of the rolls. My dyeing partners say it was yarn CV, your side blamed our feeders. How do we prevent round two?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 4% 加双向罚则——合理。现在说难点：你上批坯布 8% 的卷有横档。我的染厂朋友说纱线条干问题，你们说是我们路数张力。怎么避免重蹈覆辙？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 客观分析横档成因，提出双方各自的验证动作
key_phrases: we will provide Uster report per lot
rounds.common_mistakes: barre 是横档；别含糊说 line problem，要讲清成因验证路径。
rounds.tips_zh: 横档成因排查顺序：纱线 CV → 输纱器张力 → 织针磨损 → 弯纱深度。先小批量试织验证。
rounds.user_response_example: Let's not argue root cause blind. We will send the Uster report for each yarn lot, you run a feeder tension calibration on the machine, and we trial-knit 200 kg before committing the bulk.

rounds.ai_message: Trial knit works. If the 200 kg trial passes your four-point check under 15 points, we proceed. If barre shows again, who eats the trial cost?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 试织可以。200 公斤试样四分制低于 15 分就放大货。如果又出横档，试织成本谁担？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 提出按责任分摊试织成本
key_phrases: if yarn CV fails, we pay
if feeder tension is off, you absorb it
rounds.common_mistakes: 别一口答应 all on us 或全推给对方；按成因分摊才专业。
rounds.tips_zh: 试织成本按成因归属分摊是行业惯例，写进邮件确认。
rounds.user_response_example: Split it by root cause. If the Uster data shows yarn CV above spec, we pay the trial. If your feeder tension calibration is off, you absorb it. Neutral ground: a third-party test on the trial rolls.

rounds.ai_message: Deal. One more commercial point — your buyer now wants the fabric sanforized-equivalent, meaning compaction at the dye house. That pushes finished GSM tolerance tighter. Can you accept plus-minus 3% instead of 5%?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 成交。还有一个商务点——你客人现在要求做类似预缩的致密整理，成品克重公差要收紧。你能接受正负 3% 代替 5% 吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 评估克重公差收紧的风险，提出对应条件
key_phrases: we control greige GSM at plus-minus 3%
rounds.common_mistakes: 别把坯布公差和成品公差混为一谈；致密整理后克重不完全由针织厂控制。
rounds.tips_zh: 克重公差责任分界：针织厂对坯布克重负责，染厂对成品负责；PI 里分开写。
rounds.user_response_example: Plus-minus 3% on finished GSM is not fully in our control — compaction sits with the dye house. We can guarantee greige GSM at plus-minus 3%, and we will co-sign the compaction spec with your dye house for the finished target.

rounds.ai_message: Reasonable. Then let me put the commercial frame on the table: 2,400 kg at US$4.50, first 1,200 kg at 4% rush, trial 200 kg billed at cost, greige GSM plus-minus 3%, four-point under 15 points. Payment TT 30/70. Anything I missed?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 合理。那我把商务框架摆出来：2,400 公斤每公斤 4.5 美元，前 1,200 公斤加 4% 加急，试织 200 公斤按成本价，坯布克重正负 3%，四分制 15 分以内，付款 TT 30/70。有遗漏吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 补充检验报告、疵点扣款和交期罚则
rounds.common_mistakes: 框架复述时要主动补扣款条款，别只确认对方说的。
rounds.tips_zh: 大货合同常规补：疵布降级折价、交期延误按周罚款、检验报告随货。
rounds.user_response_example: Two additions. First, a defect allowance clause — rolls above 15 points ship as second grade at a 12% discount. Second, late delivery penalty of 0.5% per week, capped at 5%. Everything else I can live with.

rounds.ai_message: Twelve percent discount on second grade is steep — I can give 8%. And the late penalty only counts after a 3-day grace period. Take it or leave it, Amy, my margin is already thin on the rush half.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 降级折价 12% 太狠——我最多 8%。延误罚款也要 3 天宽限期后才开始算。行就行，不行就算了 Amy，加急那半单我利润已经很薄了。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在折价和宽限期上各让一步，锁定整体利益
rounds.common_mistakes: 被 take it or leave it 顶住就全盘接受；用交换条件反将。
rounds.tips_zh: 对方亮底线时，用数字对数字交换：让 2% 折价换宽限期缩短，总账不输。
rounds.user_response_example: Meet me at 10% on second grade and I will accept a 2-day grace period. That is my final position — you keep a workable margin, and my buyer keeps their quality floor.

rounds.ai_message: Ten percent, 2-day grace — done. I will issue the PI tonight with the trial plan, rush schedule, GSM tolerance, four-point limit, defect allowance and penalty clauses. Counter-sign by Thursday and we start feeder calibration on Friday.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 10%、2 天宽限——成交。我今晚发 PI，含试织方案、加急排产、克重公差、四分制上限、降级折价和罚则。周四前回签，周五我们做输纱器张力校准。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认回签时间，安排试织见证
key_phrases: our QC will witness the trial knit
rounds.common_mistakes: 收尾别只说 thanks；把试织见证和记录要求钉死。
rounds.tips_zh: 试织要派 QC 现场见证并留弯纱深度、机速、张力记录，是大货争议时的证据。
rounds.user_response_example: We will counter-sign by Thursday. Our QC will witness the trial knit on site — please keep the stitch length, machine speed and feeder tension records from the calibration. Talk soon, Tony.
